open_points.subject: Secrets in service-returned files
open_points.text: “A service's own answer body that echoes one verbatim is withheld from everyone” conflicts with “the kernel does not inspect file content.”
open_points.question: Does verbatim-secret detection apply to file bodies that the kernel only spools between operation nodes; if so, how can the kernel detect them without inspecting file content, and if not, what observable protection applies?
options: Inspect file bytes for verbatim configured secrets and withhold matching files
Do not inspect files; protect even verbatim secrets inside them only according to the answer's disclosure class
Reject or withhold all service-returned files whose safety cannot be established without inspection
open_points.default_guess: Do not inspect file content and protect secrets inside files only according to the service answer's declared disclosure class.
